s_21db7.text_1: Allay Couriers can target players for delivery.
s_21db7.text_3: Use "@player" in the address field to target a player.
s_21db7.title: Allay Couriers and Players
scene_1.text_1: Cargo Allay Stations can be used to deliver packages remotely.
scene_1.text_2: Set this station's address in its interface.
scene_1.text_6: Cargo Allay Stations automatically pull packages from the Packager or container below and dispatch an Allay Courier to the specified Cargo Allay Station.
scene_1.text_8: The interface lets you configure whether the Allay Courier returns after delivery.
scene_1.text_9: Allay Couriers have no delivery range limit and can even travel between dimensions.
